root.side_title:
Introduction
Kobool was built to be unique and different than other marriage web sites in its effective matchmaking methodology.
Kobool is also using a unique method in charging its members for providing the matchmaking service.
While almost all other marriage web sites charge their members in advance on a timely basis with no guarantee on the results, Kobool charges only members who successfully found their right matches with mutual acceptances and after exchanging photos and all possible questions and answers.

root.detailed_instructions:
What are "Contact Points" and how they are used?
"Contact Points" are required for couples whom were matched via Kobool Acceptance Matching operation, so that they can exchange written messages and take serious steps in their relationships.

Also "Contact Points" give their owners the privilege of being listed for free in the Featured Members list.

Upon buying "Contact Points", they will be added to buyer's profile and will be ready to be used either for owner or for the member the owner has matched with.

Without using "Contact Points", matched couples can only exchange predefined messages provided by Kobool that will help them initiating the communication and exchange personal pictures to make sure that they still have the desire to continue their relationship.

Kobool payment system is designed so that each party of the matched couple will be responsible for 50% of the cost of the acquaintance.
That is mainly to achieve fairness and to make sure both sides are serious about marriage.

For that, two Contact Points are required to be able to exchange written message between a matched couple.
Each party would be responsible for buying and using one Contact Point.

When one member of the matched couple buys and uses one Contact Point he/she will be able to write messages to the other immediately.
But, the other member will not be able to read those written messages until he/she buys and use the second Point.

If the other member didn't buy and use the second Point and one of this couple declined from the relationship with the other, the first Point used by the first member will become re-usable for future matches.

Kobool gives the option for one member to buy and use the two required Contact Points if that member voluntarily wants to do that in behalf of the second member.
In this case Kobool bears no responsibility if the second member was not serious about marriage.
